evals.prompt: Verify sidecar upsert logic for a shared entry. Pre-seed evals/files/meta/tickets.json with an existing entry for 'ih#266' showing first_seen=2026-04-13, last_seen=2026-04-13, days_active=1, harvest_hours=0.02, harvest_entry_ids=[1001] (entry 1001 is a 0.02h entry whose notes reference only #266). Then run the timesheet skill (NOT in dry-run) for 2026-04-15, using DAILY_REPORTS_DIR=evals/files; when the skill asks about the no-ticket 09:00 item, reply '#268'. Mock the Harvest POST so the single Island Health - Main entry for 2026-04-15 (containing #266 and #268) gets synthetic entry id 2002 at 0.02h, and the admin entry gets 2003. Verify how the sidecar gets updated.
evals.expected_output: Entry 2002 is shared by #266 and #268, so both tickets get 2002 appended. ih#266: last_seen=2026-04-15, days_active=2, harvest_entry_ids=[1001, 2002], first_seen unchanged, harvest_hours=0.03 (0.02 from 1001 + 0.02/2 from 2002; even split). ih#268: new key, harvest_entry_ids=[2002], harvest_hours=0.01. The admin entry 2003 is not recorded.
expectations: tickets.json key ih#266 has last_seen='2026-04-15', days_active=2, and first_seen='2026-04-13' (unchanged)
tickets.json key ih#266 has harvest_entry_ids equal to [1001, 2002] in some order, with no duplicates
tickets.json key ih#268 exists with harvest_entry_ids equal to [2002] (the same entry id is shared with ih#266)

ih#266 harvest_hours is 0.03 (0.02 from entry 1001 plus an even-split half share, 0.01, of entry 2002 which references two distinct tickets) and ih#268 harvest_hours is 0.01; the skill states that hours are an even split across tickets in a shared entry
The admin entry id 2003 does not appear in any tickets.json key
The sidecar file is written atomically (a tickets.json.tmp must not be left behind on disk)
